These fixtures are written by hand from the fields documented for
`brew info --json=v2` and `brew outdated --json=v2`. They are not recordings
of a real brew run. Replace them with recorded output when a working brew is
available, and keep the same file names.

The files named recorded_* are the exception: they are real output from
Homebrew 7.0.13 on Linux (homebrew/core git revision f3756358aef), so they
have no casks. Cask fixtures are still hand-written.
